lina_cs: Quick sync — Ember alpha cohort enrollment looks lower than forecast (6/20 seats filled). I'm worried about renewal signal if product teams don't get value. Can we do an enablement push?

Derek: On it. I can run a hands-on session next Tue (Mar 19). What materials do you want?

lina_cs: Agenda: 1) quick product walkthrough, 2) integration checklist, 3) prompt tuning clinic. Need a slide deck + 30m lab. Also want to collect feedback during the session via short poll.

oliver_pm: I'll share a 6-slide deck + runbook. Would love to capture feature asks in a simple form — maybe a google form. I can host the poll.

maya_enable: Can we do two identical sessions for EMEA-friendly times? I can cover the 10am PT and 6pm CET slots. I'll draft the invite.

opsbot: calendar invite created: Ember alpha enablement — Tue Mar 19 10:00 PT / 18:00 CET. Link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/ember-12345

lina_cs: Perfect. Derek — can you prepare one short example integration (30 lines) so customers can paste and run? Something with embeddings + reranking.

Derek: Yep. I'll drop a minimal snippet in the shared drive by EOD today:
```
# python snippet
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key='${API_KEY}')
resp = c.rerank(model='tiny-rank', query='invoice matching', documents=["Inv 123", "Invoice 124"]) 
print(resp)
```

oliver_pm: I'll put the feedback form link in the invite and include 3 quick diagnostic questions about seat usage + renewal intent.

lina_cs: Also flag: two accounts show low weekly active users — Ember-Intl and Ember-Data. Maya, can you own outreach for Ember-Intl?

maya_enable: On it. I'll do 1:1 check-ins with the two admins and attach suggested playbook snippets. ETA Wed EOD.

lina_cs: Thanks. Action items: Derek snippet (EOD), Oliver deck + form (tomorrow AM), Maya outreach (Wed EOD), I'll prep success metrics and renewal risk tags. We'll reconvene after sessions to roll up feedback.

oliver_pm: :thumbsup: Sounds good.

opsbot: thread archived after 7 days of inactivity.
